rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a generally dull or monotonous quality, including an unvaried life.

example.english: Going to work and coming home every day gives my whole life a sense of drabness.
example.traditional: 日日返工放工，成個生活都有種單調感。
example.jyutping: jat6 jat6 faan1 gung1 fong3 gung1 seng4 go3 saang1 wut6 dou1 jau5 zung2 daan1 diu6 gam2

rows.note: Use this when the drabness is experienced as a tedious or oppressive atmosphere, especially in daily life.

example.english: There is a real sense of drabness in this house when nobody talks for so long.
example.traditional: 呢間屋成日冇人講嘢，坐耐咗真係有種沉悶感。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 uk1 seng4 jat6 mou5 jan4 gong2 je5 co5 noi6 zo2 zan1 hai6 jau5 zung2 cam4 mun6 gam2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a visually dull, colourless, or gloomy appearance rather than routine monotony.

example.english: With such gray walls, the whole room has a sense of drabness.
example.traditional: 牆身啲顏色咁灰，成間屋都有種灰暗感。
example.jyutping: coeng4 san1 di1 ngaan4 sik1 gam3 fui1 sing4 gaan1 uk1 dou1 jau5 zung2 fui1 am3 gam2
